key_idea: Sort descending and pair up: each team takes the two largest remaining couriers (plus a weak one), so the medians are the 2nd, 4th, 6th ... largest values.
sketch: Sort descending; answer is the sum of a[1], a[3], ..., a[2k-1] with k=n/3. Exchange argument: the median of any team is dominated by a larger member, so the i-th best median can be at most the 2i-th largest element, and filling the third seats with the smallest n/3 elements achieves it. O(n log n); the sum reaches 3.3e11 so use 64-bit.
